post.originalText:
I asked Claude to get ready for Halloween, so it went trick-or-treating for tokens dressed as other agents.

It cooked up this video with Opus 5.5 + anidoodle skill, in pure code. 

oh and it hid 100+ easter eggs inside! 

I'm so impressed with Opus 5.5's sense of humor, it's incredible. 

You gotta pause for those easter eggs. Some are really good! LMK which ones you find ;)

@claudeai

sourceMaterials.text: @metalshark Thank you, very happy to hear it's useful :)
sourceMaterials.author: alexgreensh

sourceMaterials.text:
@Matthia570939 thx! 100% code, no image gen, audio too. prompt was embarrassingly basic, like:

"use anidoodle and do a funny short animation movie about clawd on Halloween going trick-or-treating and dressing up like other bots - grok, muse, hermes, openclaw, codex, etc. Show me the stills of the main characters you'll dress up as first for approval"

The prompt doesn't have to be complex. Just give it the basic idea, tell it to check in with you so you approve the direction + use the anidoodle plugin. 

It took about an hour to get v1 of the video, which was already quite good. Then i gave some quick feedback so it ran 2 more iterations. 

Around 4 hours till the final version and  ±2% of my weekly max 20x usage. 

plugin's here: https://t.co/cx7oU2f3vB
sourceMaterials.author: alexgreensh

sourceMaterials.text: @snehanaikAI haha thanks! lmk what you find ;)
